## Workload

Tomas Brennan completed 613 reads during 418 hours of grading activity. This represents an average rate of 1.5 reads per hour. The workload recorded for the review period is therefore consistent with the stated hours and throughput.

The figures provide a summary of the volume handled by the grader and the time allocated to that work. They are presented for review by Priya Anand.

## Quality

A total of 56 reads were checked as part of the quality review. The level of agreement between Tomas Brennan and Priya Anand was 44.6 per cent.

The review records both the number of reads checked and the resulting agreement measure. These findings should be considered alongside the workload information when assessing the grading activity. Priya Anand completed the review of the work submitted by Tomas Brennan.
